notes.title: Update Version 1.3 – February 13, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
———————————— Fixed ————————————

[Fixed] An issue where the special attack animation of the exclusive weapon "Landient" would play abnormally after El’s class change to Valkyrie.

[Fixed] Missing Whip item in the prison chapter’s treasure chest.

[Fixed] Rescue mechanics not functioning properly in Hell Difficulty.

[Fixed] A bug preventing players from obtaining the Beam Rifle in New Game+ mode.

[Fixed] Incorrect character portraits during the orc battle in Chapter 25.

[Fixed] Portrait display error for the character Balzac.

Optimizations & Adjustments
———————————— Updates ————————————

[Optimized] Smoother fade-in/fade-out transitions in battle scenes for enhanced visual fluidity.

[Optimized] Added more hidden trigger units in New Game+ mode, enriching exploration and tactical depth!

[Optimized] Improved compatibility and stability for Windows 11.

[Optimized] UI adjustments for character stats to better fit Steam Deck displays.

[Remastered] Fully redesigned character artwork for Balzac.

New Features
———————————— Added ————————————

[Added] Marriage System – Exchange rings and form a sacred vow with your chosen partner once bond levels are maxed!

[Added] Free Map Exploration – Venture beyond the main story to uncover hidden secrets across the world!

[Added] Gallery Mode – Collect and revisit all in-game CGs.

[Added] Music Room – Relive epic moments by freely listening to the game’s soundtrack.

With this update, Sigil Chronicles 2: Seven Sacred Heroes concludes its year-long development journey, marking the completion of all planned content. A heartfelt thank you to all players for your unwavering support!

The adventure continues…
Stay tuned for Sigil Chronicles 3 – where new legends await! 🎉

notes.title: Countermark Saga 2 Version 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
————————————Fixes————————————

Fixed the issue of obtaining duplicate weapons in New Game+.

Fixed the issue where Hell difficulty could not be selected after clearing Hard mode in New Game+.

Corrected a typo in the checkpoint of Chapter 28.

Fixed a bug where the checkpoint in Chapter 28 could lead directly to the ending.

Fixed the issue where the Frog Archer could not move on land; it is now classified as a shallow water unit.

Fixed the issue where the Teleportation Stone [Ugly] was not obtained during the Chapter 6 checkpoint.

Corrected the description error for the "Fervor" skill.

Changed the treasure chest opening mechanic to occupy the chest's tile directly instead of an adjacent tile.

————————————Updates—————————————

Teleportation Stones can now be sold.

Added additional story content for Kira and her sibling in Chapter 21.

Added a split-screen feature for battles, making terrain differences more visually impactful.

All weapons of the Seven Saints are now exclusive and cannot be exchanged.

Updated the character portraits for the male and female protagonists in the prologue.

————————————Additions—————————————

Added a character introduction system, featuring detailed profiles for approximately 53 characters.

Introduced a Bonding System to enhance interactions between characters.

Added a new character, Lian, from "World in Your Eyes 2" (an early crossover before the game's official release).

Added a new character, Redheart (with a complex recruitment process).

Added a new character, Vivian.

Added a new character, Balzac (currently in development).

Added a [Tavern] feature during intermission preparations for more interactive options.

Added Free Map 1: Border Village.

————————————Next Update Preview————————————

A Marriage System will be introduced, deepening character relationships.

Free Maps: Approximately 10 new stages will be added.

This update aims to enhance your gaming experience, address known issues, and bring more exciting content. Stay tuned for future updates!



Dear Heroes,

As the Spring Festival approaches, we welcome a new beginning! On this special occasion, the entire development team of "Countermark Saga 2" extends our heartfelt gratitude and warmest wishes to all our players. Your unwavering support and feedback have made this fantastical world even more vibrant and engaging.

In this Spring Festival update, we’ve brought you a wealth of new content and optimizations: the Bonding System deepens the connections between characters, new heroes join the adventure, and features like Free Maps and split-screen battles enrich your gameplay experience. We hope these updates bring you joy and excitement during the holiday season!

A new year, a new journey! The story of the Seven Saints will continue to unfold, with even more exciting content on the horizon—marriage systems, new free maps, and more are coming soon. May 2025 be another year of adventure and legend-making with us!

Finally, we wish you and your family a happy Spring Festival, good health, and prosperity in the Year of the Dragon! May your adventures in "Countermark Saga 2" be filled with joy and unforgettable moments!

—Sincerely,
The Development Team of "Countermark Saga 2"
January 28, 2025

————————————Dev Notes————————————


What I need everyone to understand is that, as a solo developer, my capacity is indeed limited. Every day, I strive to improve and update the game to the best of my ability. All the development, bug fixes, and updates are handled by me alone, so I ask for your patience and understanding.

From now on, I’ll release regular updates, and after each one, I’ll post an announcement. The announcement will be divided into three sections: 【Fixes】, 【Updates】, and 【New Additions】.

Fixes: Based on player feedback, I’ll fix bugs promptly to ensure continuous game optimization. Updates: This covers updates to character models, effects, etc. New Additions: Includes new content like stages, items, characters, etc.

I'll make sure to bring new surprises with each update!

Finally, a huge thank you to all the players supporting me! Game development is no easy feat, and making sure you enjoy the game is my primary motivation. If anyone still feels like this is a paid beta, maybe wait until the end of October to grab the full version and experience it then!
